name: k g mulvaney
quote:
At short notice Sisira helped us with a travel plan to explore the southern parts of Sri Lanka. His knowledge and expertise helped us develop a fantastic trip. His communication was good, although we did need to prompt to clear understanding of the mileage allowances.
Overall we had an excellent vacation and to have someone on the ground helping us made the trip a delight as we got a lot more insight-into the life and history of Sri Lanka. Thank you so much
